authorizationEvidence.attachment: Owner phone screenshot of /ko airport glance: "전월비 일평균 증감 Top 5" ranked by rate (투르크메니스탄 +38.5% … 태국 +12.5%), "공항 상세 ↗" below it, "국가 전체 보기 (45) ↗" above.

decisions.ranking: Top 5 and the growth tile rank by the change in included-day DAILY MEAN departures (flights/day), largest increase first; ties: higher current mean, then country name.
decisions.whyDailyMean: The selected month is usually partial (the screenshot: previous 30 included days / selected 13), so month totals would compare different spans; the table already shows daily means (일평균 · 편/일).
decisions.newDestinations: A destination with mean 0 last month is a real increase (+N) and is kept; an incomparable month (no data) still yields nothing.
decisions.display: Change column "증감" shows the signed count (+2.1; △ for a decrease, the page's existing flight-count convention; 0 for none; a nonzero change below 0.1 keeps its direction as <0.1) with spoken 증가/감소 words for screen readers; the growth tile shows +N편/일.

links.Top 5 공항 상세 / growth tile: #airport-month-destinations — the monthly "목적지 국가·지역 전체" list, opened (only the full list is guaranteed to contain every Top 5 country)
links.출국장 대기: #airport-checkpoints-title; for 탑승동 the T1 checkpoints (the tile already shows T1 queues; the concourse page has no checkpoint section)
links.앞으로 출발편 집중 시간 / 지도 공항 상세: #airport-departure-model-slot; for 탑승동 #airport-concourse (the concourse page has no departure map)

decisions.landing: The airport page reveals these ids after its client data mounts (app/use-airport-hash-reveal.ts): waits for the id, aligns it below the sticky header and airport menu, opens a closed <details>, keeps it aligned while content above settles, stops at the first scroll/tap/key or after 8 s. Root cause: full page loads whose target sections are not in the server HTML and mount 0.7–1.4 s after load, so the browser fragment scroll had already given up (scrollY stayed 0).
